crossRefs.note: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),
and with them their brothers of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah…
Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s…
He set the gatekeepers at the gates of Yahweh’s house, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.
The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation…
We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out…
the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites…

people.name: Ebiasaph
people.line: Levite descendant of Korah, ancestor of temple gatekeepers

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

people.name: Meshelemiah
people.line: A Levite gatekeeper in the time of David.

translations.web: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
translations.bsb: These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites: Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph.
translations.kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
translations.asv: For the courses of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
